yeti: A yeti, an enormous shaggy ape-like creature standing upright on two legs in snow, covered in thick coarse OFF-WHITE AND PALE SILVER-GREY FUR, with a heavy sloping brow, small dark deep-set eyes, massive sloping shoulders, long powerful arms and broad flat feet. Heavy and bear-like rather than man-like, huge and unhurried
wendigo: A wendigo, a tall gaunt forest spirit standing upright, its ashen grey hide stretched tight over a STARVED RIBCAGE and long thin limbs, with a great rack of BRANCHING ANTLERS rising from a narrow elongated skull, deep shadowed eye sockets, and long arms ending in hooked claws. Skeletal, towering and cold
encantado: An encantado, an Amazon river dolphin: a PINK freshwater dolphin with a LONG SLENDER BEAK lined with small teeth, a bulging rounded melon forehead, a flexible neck letting it turn its head to look sideways at the viewer, small eyes, a LOW RIDGE INSTEAD OF A DORSAL FIN, and broad paddle-shaped flippers
mamiwata: Mami Wata, a West African water spirit in mermaid form: a woman from the waist up with rich dark brown skin, long flowing black hair and gold ornaments at her neck and wrists, and from the waist down a powerful TEAL-GREEN AND GOLD FISH TAIL with wide flowing fins, a large patterned snake coiled about her shoulders and arms
